game_title: Nested While Dungeon – Crystal Grotto Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Shadow Cave – Crystal Grotto, a grotto of glowing crystals: the spelunker must handle rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Nested While Dungeon: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor.
theme: Shadow Cave – Crystal Grotto: a grotto of glowing crystals
core_gameplay_loop: In Crystal Grotto, repeat each round: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor. Each round, rock golems strike the wooden door, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the dungeon_clear value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the wooden door from rock golems in Crystal Grotto: keep the dungeon_clear meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 26-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: dungeon_clear drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 26-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 2 (intro tier): Nested While Dungeon
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
